correctness.rationale: For every \(0<a<2/5\), the LL and RR inequalities prohibit a future switch; alternating bounded branch iterates force endpoints 0 and 1, and constant tails force 1/3 and 2/3. At \(a=2/5\), the sole switch after a repeated symbol forces the explicit 4-cycle. All survivor points are preperiodic; finite-to-one branches give countability and recurrence plus the variational principle give \(h_{\mathrm{top}}=0\). Primitive-orbit enumeration gives the exact zeta and n-th fixed-point formulas. Exact Fraction-based diagnostics for \(n\le13\) corroborate, but do not prove, the all-n theorem.

value.rationale: An exact natural finite regime is completely classified for all real hole widths through the first surviving primitive 4-cycle, not for an arbitrary isolated numerical parameter. The two sharp thresholds distinguish nonconjugate periodic spectra while htop is identically zero, supplying concrete invariant structure that entropy-only plateau theorems cannot see. The compact zeta formula is usable for exact periodic-point enumeration and tests at parameter boundaries.
